lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. The centroids are arranged in a semi-regular grid with spacing roughly equal to 1.5-2 diameters of individual blobs, extending from the posterior gill region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, forming distinct anchor nodes particularly visible along the mid-lateral line.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature with a sharp vertical intensity gradient—light on the dorsal side, shadow on the ventral side—runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of faint, low-contrast high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered near the leading edge and lower base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregularly shaped high-intensity white patch is visible on the dorsal surface just posterior to the head region, indicating significant tissue trauma or a persistent lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of high-luminance spots compared to the main body trunk, specifically along its trailing edge.
